text:
Maria (CSM): Heads up — we need to prep the AtlasOps EBR for Tue 6/4 9:00am PT. Goal: health summary, onboarding status, renewal discussion, and exec ask. Who can own slides?

Aj (AE): I can own the renewal slide and lead the contract Q&A. Renewal window opens 6/18. Customer execs: CTO + Head of Ops likely to attend.

Helen (Enablement): I’ll take adoption & enablement slides (training uptake, enablement sessions run). Will add short playbook and recommended next steps.

Kevin (PM): I can do roadmap + a 2-min demo of the batching/quantization improvements. Need 2 slides + a screenshot or short recording. Any constraints on demos (network/infra)?

Sam (Analytics): I’ll deliver usage metrics and the health score. Plan to include: DAU, token volume, tail-latency 95/99, error rate, and churn signal. Putting together a SQL extract and a one-sheet snapshot. Example query I'll share: ```SELECT date, sum(tokens) as tokens, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency) as p95 FROM usage WHERE customer_id='atlasops' GROUP BY date;```

Maria (CSM): Nice. Action items so far: Aj - renewal slide & customer exec alignment (due 6/2), Helen - enablement slides + playbook (due 6/2), Kevin - roadmap + demo (due 6/2), Sam - metrics + anomalies (due 6/1). I’ll assemble the deck and do the exec intro. Adding :thumbsup:. Shared drive: https://drive.redwood/AtlasOps/EBR (use that for final slides).

Tom (VP CS): Add a dedicated "renewal risk" slide with ask + decision needed. If there's a gap, propose a commercial/technical mitigation. I’ll join the first 10 min for exec alignment.

Aj (AE): Flag — we saw intermittent latency spikes last month tied to long contexts. That may surface as a risk. Sam, can you include a short RCA blurb and the mitigation plan we'll propose?

Sam (Analytics): Will include incident summary. Two spikes on 5/11 and 5/23 correlated with longer prompt lengths and a hot-spot on a few endpoints. I'll attach logs and a small visualization. Snippet of planned notes: ```Incidents: 5/11 (latency p99 2.7s), 5/23 (p99 3.1s). Root cause: uneven batching + KV cache eviction. Mitigation: enable prefix caching + bump batch threshold; expected p99 reduction ~30%.```

Helen (Enablement): For enablement, propose a short pilot: 3 sessions + playbook for engineering to adopt prefix caching + guidance on prompt length. Success criteria: reduce p99 latency by 25% and increase feature usage by 15% within 30 days. I’ll prepare the pilot slide.

Maria (CSM): Perfect. Two more asks: 1) Exec one-pager: one slide with "ask, impact, decision needed" — Tom you can sign off? 2) Capture customer feedback themes — please drop top 3 pieces of feedback into the deck notes (bugs, feature asks, docs gaps).

Tom (VP CS): I’ll review the exec slide and the ask. Also suggest we propose a short SLA uplift or tech credit if mitigation takes longer — include as optional concession on the renewal slide.

Aj (AE): Sounds good. I’ll loop in legal for concession language if we surface it.

Sam (Analytics): I'll upload the CSV + dashboard link to the shared drive by EOD tomorrow.

Kevin (PM): Quick Q: for the demo I need a stable model instance. Can infra spin up a canary instance with quantized weights for AtlasOps? @Infra (cc eng-infra) — if someone can confirm, I’ll record the clip.

Maria (CSM): Final note — please drop final slides in the "Final" folder by Friday EOD (6/2). I’ll send calendar invite when I have confirmation of exec availability. Thanks all — short sync if needed Thu morning. :calendar:
